cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Let Go of the Grudge
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender resentment, distance, or a claim that keeps the relationship stuck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Come sit beside me at dinner. I know you're still angry I missed your opening night.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You left that seat empty. You can have an empty one tonight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I deserved that last night. Could tonight's seat have you in it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm still going to tell you what you missed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please do. Move your plate over; I want to hear every scene.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: B

mechanism: A uses precise conversational and seating arrangements to persuade B to stop punishing distance for a missed opening while still making room to hear the hurt.
confusable: D74 keeps someone until repair; D84 specifically asks resentment or distance be surrendered so relationship can move.
comparison: Moving alternative earns trust through handling birthday glasses; dinner alternative invites detailed performance account as a way out of punitive empty seating.
seedUse: Missed opening, empty seat, dinner plate and every scene derive from D84-a; S03 adds exact one-at-a-time listening and seating correction.
